messages.subject: Energy & Infrastructure Executive | ESG, External Affairs & Strategic Leadership
messages.body:
Dear Cormis Partners Team,

Your executive-search focus across energy, utilities, infrastructure and industrial leadership aligns strongly with my international profile. I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group, with leadership responsibilities spanning government and regulatory relations, ESG and social performance, corporate and external affairs, stakeholder strategy, strategic partnerships and executive communications. I am targeting Director, VP, Country and Regional leadership mandates where energy or infrastructure growth requires institutional trust, regulatory coordination, responsible development and disciplined execution. Saudi Arabia and the UAE are priority markets, and I am internationally mobile.

My executive CV is attached for confidential consideration.

Best regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
